options_evaluated: Post-consumer recycled (PCR) Polypropylene (PP) with monomaterial design and structural ribs
High-impact virgin ABS/PC blend with internal structural ribbing
decisions.conflict: Material and Design, Manufacture, and Circularity agents recommend recycled monomaterial Polypropylene to maximize recyclability and lower carbon footprint, whereas the In-Service agent rejects this in favor of virgin ABS/PC to ensure impact durability and prevent suction leaks.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material durability vs end-of-life recyclability and recycled content
decisions.chief_resolution: Monomaterial Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) Polypropylene (PP) with structural ribs.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of PCR PP suppliers capable of meeting structural and aesthetic requirements.

options_evaluated: Reversible mechanical fasteners (standardized screws with threaded metal inserts)
Molded-in snap-fit joints without metal inserts
Permanent adhesive bonding and ultrasonic welding
decisions.conflict: The Manufacture agent recommends direct snap-fit joints to eliminate fasteners and simplify assembly, while the Material and Design, In-Service, and Circularity agents reject this because snap-fits are highly prone to breaking during repair and EOL disassembly, advocating for reversible mechanical fasteners.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing simplicity vs ease of disassembly and repairability
decisions.chief_resolution: Reversible mechanical fasteners (standardized screws with threaded metal inserts).
decisions.design_action: Confirm the standardization of screw thread sizes and insert specifications across the assembly.

options_evaluated: High-efficiency modular Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with easily extractable neodymium magnets
Rare-earth-free synchronous reluctance motor with recycled copper windings
decisions.conflict: Material and Design and Manufacture agents recommend a rare-earth-free synchronous reluctance motor to avoid critical raw materials and manufacturing emissions, whereas In-Service and Circularity agents recommend a high-efficiency BLDC motor to ensure high suction efficiency and durability during the use phase.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: critical raw material reduction vs use-phase energy efficiency and performance
decisions.chief_resolution: High-efficiency modular Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with easily extractable neodymium magnets.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the supply chain for modular BLDC motors with easily extractable magnet assemblies.

options_evaluated: Forced-air cooling using main suction airflow with open, conformal-coated PCBs and washable filters
Active cooling with auxiliary fan, recycled aluminum heatsinks, and potted electronics
Passive cooling via high-thermal-conductivity bio-composite housing
decisions.conflict: Manufacture and Circularity agents recommend using the main aerodynamic suction airflow for cooling to eliminate extra components and potting, whereas In-Service and Material and Design agents recommend an active cooling fan with dedicated heatsinks and filters to prevent motor overheating when the main suction path is clogged.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material minimization vs thermal reliability and component protection
decisions.chief_resolution: Forced-air cooling using main suction airflow with open, conformal-coated PCBs and washable filters.
decisions.design_action: Verify the thermal limits of conformal coatings and the filtration efficiency of washable filters under bypass airflow conditions.

options_evaluated: Fully modular architecture with plug-and-play functional modules (motor, cord reel, electronics)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections and integrated motor-fan assembly
Monolithic integrated design with non-replaceable components
decisions.conflict: The Manufacture agent recommends a monolithic integrated design to minimize production complexity and assembly waste, while Material and Design, In-Service, and Circularity agents demand a fully modular, plug-and-play architecture to enable easy repair, component swapping, and EOL recycling.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing simplicity vs product lifetime extension and repairability
decisions.chief_resolution: Fully modular architecture with plug-and-play functional modules.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability and cost of standardized plug-and-play electrical connectors for modular sub-assemblies.

options_evaluated: Corded AC power with a user-replaceable heavy-duty power cord (manual wrap)
Corded AC power with an automatic mechanical cord reel
decisions.conflict: The Material and Design agent recommends a corded AC power system with an automatic cord reel to improve storage convenience, whereas In-Service and Manufacture agents reject this mechanism due to its high failure rate and manufacturing complexity, preferring a simple, user-replaceable heavy-duty power cord.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: user convenience mechanisms vs mechanical reliability and repairability
decisions.chief_resolution: Corded AC power with a user-replaceable heavy-duty power cord (manual wrap).
decisions.design_action: Investigate user acceptance and regulatory requirements for manual cord storage options.
